prompt: Use java.time.Period to break the span between two fixed dates into years, months, and days, returned as an int array.
explanation: Period.between(start, end) decomposes a date span into calendar-aware years, months, and days, handling different month lengths and leap years for you. The three parts come from getYears(), getMonths(), and getDays(). Contrast this with ChronoUnit, which measures a span in one single unit such as total days.
hints: java.time.Period.between(birth, on) returns a Period object describing the gap.
Pull the parts out with p.getYears(), p.getMonths(), and p.getDays(), then pack them into a new int[].
